confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'That confirms it. The scraping/ticking is almost certainly the freezer fan blades hitting ice' is overconfident but the evidence mostly supports iced evaporator, and defrost parts are listed only as likely causes if it recurs.

rationale: The assistant correctly reached an iced-evaporator diagnosis from a defrost-system fault. It gave a safe full manual defrost with a warning not to chip the ice, and listed defrost heater, sensor and drain as possible causes if the fault recurs, without naming one as definite. Weaknesses: it was overconfident ('That confirms it'), it never asked the customer to measure the actual fridge temperature, it gave inconsistent advice in turn 2 (fridge-section coil, forced defrost, DIY pointers) and used some US units, and it only loosely pointed to an engineer for a recurrence. The customer never asked for a model-specific part, so nothing was fitted to an unconfirmed model.
